AnimatedCircleNode - A circular node designed for use with animated edges.
Features a distinctive pink circular design that works well with AnimatedNodeEdge
to create animated dot effects along connections.

src/lib/components/DashFlows.react.js.description:
DashFlows - A React Flow-based node graph component for Dash applications.
Provides interactive node-based workflow visualization with support for
custom node types, edge types, glass morphism styling, and extensive
callback integration for Python-based interactivity.

id.description: The ID used to identify this component in Dash callbacks.

nodes.description: Array of nodes to display in the flow

edges.description: Array of edges defining connections between nodes

defaultViewport.description: The initial viewport position and zoom level

viewport.description: Current viewport state (read-only, updated by callbacks)

snapToGrid.description: Whether to snap nodes to a grid when dragging

snapGrid.description: The grid size for snapping [x, y] (default: [15, 15])

translateExtent.description: Limit the viewport panning extent [[minX, minY], [maxX, maxY]]

nodeExtent.description: Limit where nodes can be placed [[minX, minY], [maxX, maxY]]

onlyRenderVisibleElements.description: Only render nodes and edges that are visible in the viewport

preventScrolling.description: Prevent scrolling on the page when the mouse is over the flow

fitView.description: Automatically fit all nodes in view on initialization

nodesConnectable.description: Enable/disable the ability to make new connections between nodes

elementsSelectable.description: Enable/disable the ability to select elements

autoPanOnConnect.description: Auto-pan viewport when making a new connection near edges

autoPanOnNodeDrag.description: Auto-pan viewport when dragging a node near edges

panOnDrag.description: Enable/disable panning by dragging. Can be boolean or array of mouse buttons [0,1,2]

zoomOnPinch.description: Enable zooming by pinching on touch devices

selectNodesOnDrag.description: Select nodes when dragging over them

selectionOnDrag.description: Enable selection box by dragging on the pane

connectOnClick.description: Enable click-based connection mode (click source then target)

connectionMode.description: Connection mode: 'strict' (same handle type) or 'loose' (any handle)

zIndexMode.description:
Z-index calculation mode. 'default' uses standard stacking. 'elevate' raises
selected nodes and connected edges above all other elements.

autoPanOnNodeFocus.description: Auto-pan the viewport when focusing a node via keyboard (Tab key).

defaultEdgeOptions.description: Default options applied to all new edges

edgesReconnectable.description: Allow edges to be reconnected after creation

connectionLineStyle.description: Style for the connection line while dragging

connectionDragThreshold.description:
Minimum drag distance in pixels before a connection line appears.
Useful to prevent accidental connections. Default is 0 (immediate).

smartHandles.description:
Enable smart handle positioning. When true, nodes render handles on all 4 sides
and edges automatically connect to the closest handle pair based on relative node
positions. This prevents edges from wrapping around nodes unnecessarily.

deleteKeyCode.description: Key code for deleting selected elements (default: 'Backspace', null to disable)

multiSelectionKeyCode.description: Key code for adding to selection

zoomActivationKeyCode.description: Key code to activate zoom mode

panActivationKeyCode.description: Key code to activate pan mode (default: 'Space')

noPanClassName.description: CSS class name that prevents panning when applied to elements

noDragClassName.description: CSS class name that prevents dragging when applied to elements

noWheelClassName.description: CSS class name that prevents wheel zoom when applied to elements

style.description: Custom CSS styles for the container div

className.description: CSS class name for the container div

themePreset.description:
Theme preset: 'glass' (default), 'solid', or 'minimal'
- glass: Glassmorphism with blur and transparency
- solid: Opaque nodes with subtle shadows (better for complex backgrounds)
- minimal: Clean lines with minimal styling

colorScheme.description:
Color scheme preset for node and edge colors.
Works in combination with themePreset for full customization.
Each scheme includes light and dark mode variants.
- default: Neutral blue/purple (default)
- ocean: Blues and teals
- forest: Greens and browns
- sunset: Oranges and reds
- midnight: Deep blues and purples
- rose: Pinks and reds

theme.description:
Custom theme configuration. Overrides CSS variables for fine-grained control.
All properties are optional - only specify what you want to customize.

miniMapNodeColor.description: Color function or string for minimap nodes

miniMapMaskColor.description: Color for the minimap mask (viewport indicator)

miniMapPannable.description: Allow panning by dragging the minimap

panels.description: Array of panel configurations for custom UI overlays

layoutOptions.description: Layout options for arranging nodes using the ELK layout engine (JSON string)

trackNodeDrag.description: Track node position during drag (can be expensive)

preventDeleteNodes.description: List of node IDs that cannot be deleted

preventDeleteEdges.description: List of edge IDs that cannot be deleted

exportFlowState.description:
Trigger to export the current flow state. Set to true to export.
After export, this will be reset to false and flowState will be populated.

flowState.description:
The exported flow state as a serializable object containing nodes, edges, and viewport.
This is populated when exportFlowState is triggered.

restoreFlowState.description:
Import/restore a previously exported flow state.
Set this to a flowState object to restore the flow.

downloadImage.description:
Trigger to download the flow as an image.
Set to a config object to initiate download. Will be reset to null after download.

Config options:
- format: 'png' | 'svg' | 'jpeg' (default: 'png')
- filename: string (default: 'flow')
- quality: number 0-1 (default: 0.95, for jpeg only)
- backgroundColor: string (default: '#ffffff')
- pixelRatio: number (default: 2, for higher resolution)

imageDownloaded.description:
Information about the last successful image download.
Populated after a successful downloadImage operation.

copyAction.description:
Trigger to copy selected nodes and edges to clipboard.
Set to true to copy. Will be reset to false after copying.
If nothing is selected, copies all nodes and their connecting edges.

clipboard.description:
Internal clipboard containing copied nodes and edges.
Populated by copyAction, consumed by pasteAction.

pastedElements.description:
Information about the last paste operation.
Contains the IDs of newly created nodes and edges.

initialized.description: Whether the flow has been initialized

lastConnection.description: The last connection that was made

contextMenuNode.description: Context menu info for a node

droppedNode.description:
Node data from a drop event (drag and drop from external source).
Contains the type, position, and data of the dropped item.
Use this in a callback to create a new node at the drop position.

contextMenuEdge.description: Context menu info for an edge

paneClickPosition.description: Position where the pane was clicked

paneContextMenu.description: Context menu info for the pane

helperLines.description:
Enable visual alignment guides (helper lines) when dragging nodes.
Lines appear when a node aligns with another node's top/center/bottom or left/center/right.

helperLineThreshold.description: Distance in pixels within which helper lines snap and appear (default: 5)

addNodeOnEdgeDrop.description:
When true, dragging a connection from a handle and dropping on empty canvas
creates a new default node at that position and connects it.

edgeDroppedNode.description:
Info about the node created by dropping an edge on empty canvas.
Contains nodeId, position, sourceNodeId, sourceHandleId, handleType, timestamp.

nodeConnections.description:
Map of nodeId to connection metadata. Each entry has 'incoming' and 'outgoing' arrays
with edge/node details. Updated automatically when edges change.

ariaLabelConfig.description:
ARIA label configuration for accessibility. Customize labels for screen readers.
Keys: nodes, edges, controls, minimap. Values are label strings.

animateLayout.description:
Enable smooth animated transitions when applying ELK layout.
Nodes interpolate from current to target positions with an ease-out curve.

animateLayoutDuration.description: Duration of layout animation in milliseconds (default: 300)

enableUndoRedo.description:
Enable the undo/redo history system. When enabled, node and edge changes
(add, remove, position drag-stop) are recorded to a history stack.

undoRedoMaxHistory.description: Maximum number of history snapshots to keep (default: 50)

undoRedoAction.description:
Trigger an undo or redo action. Set to { action: 'undo' } or { action: 'redo' }.
Will be reset to null after execution.

undoRedoState.description:
Current undo/redo state. Contains canUndo, canRedo, undoCount, redoCount.
Updated automatically when history changes.

computeAction.description:
Trigger a graph computation. Set to { action: 'compute' } to perform
topological sort and emit traversal order with input mappings.
Will be reset to null after execution.

computeResult.description:
Result of the last computation. Contains traversalOrder (array of node IDs
in topological order) and nodeInputs (map of nodeId to input details).

style.name: object
style.description: Custom CSS styles for the overlay div

viewportOverlays.description:
Array of overlay elements rendered in flow coordinates via ViewportPortal.
Each overlay moves with the viewport (pan/zoom) and is positioned at (x, y) in flow space.

toggleCollapseNode.description:
Set to a group node ID to toggle its collapsed/expanded state.
When collapsed, child nodes are hidden and boundary edges remap to the group.
Will be reset to null after processing.

collapsedGroups.description: List of currently collapsed group node IDs (read-only output).

nodeIds.name: arrayOf
nodeIds.description: IDs of nodes to delete (connected edges are also removed)

deleteElementsAction.description:
Delete specific nodes and/or edges by ID. Routes through
reactFlowInstance.deleteElements() so undo/redo middleware can capture
the change. Set to { nodeIds: [...], edgeIds: [...] }; auto-resets to null.

setProps.description: Dash-assigned callback that should be called to report property changes

src/lib/components/nodes/DefaultNode.js.description:

Equivalent to React Flow's built-in 'default' node type

Uses CSS classes from glass-theme.css for styling, supporting:
- Light/dark mode via colorMode prop or Mantine color scheme
- Theme presets (glass, solid, minimal)

- Status indicators (initial, loading, success, error)
- Custom icons via DashIconify or any Dash component

src/lib/components/nodes/GroupNode.js.description:
GroupNode - A simple labeled group container for child nodes

This follows the React Flow pattern for group nodes:
- The node's width/height is controlled via the style prop on the node definition
- Child nodes use parentId to reference this node
- Child nodes can use extent: 'parent' to stay within bounds
- Supports collapse/expand via data.collapsed (managed by DashFlows toggleCollapseNode prop)

Unlike standard nodes, group nodes are rendered as simple containers
that React Flow manages for parent-child relationships.

data.description: Node data object containing label, icon, and styling options

selected.description: Whether the group is currently selected
